data.hook: There are only four things mice physically can't tolerate, ranked from weakest to strongest.
data.desire: Find a pouch that actually makes mice leave, instead of one they ignore after a week.
data.angle: A ranked countdown of ingredients that reveals most pouches stop at the two weakest ones.
data.belief_shift: from 'peppermint pouches are all the same' → to 'most pouches only use the two weakest ingredients; the strong two are what's missing'
data.script_structure: ranked-list hook → 'number four is why 99% fail' tease → #1 peppermint, #2 cinnamon (weak) → #3 castor oil, #4 cedarwood (strong) → most pouches stop at two → Sofyre has all four, 'exterminators use it' → two days, 90 days, safe → Buy 2 Get 1
data.mechanism_reveal: Advertiser claim: peppermint and cinnamon are tolerated; castor oil causes 'respiratory issues, skin irritation'; cedarwood 'triggers a full nervous system response'; together 'they don't get used to it'.
data.proof: Ranked ingredient demos; AI body animations (lungs, nervous system); 'same stuff exterminators use in their own homes' authority claim; '99% of mouse pouches fail' statistic; checkout screenshot.
data.cta: Just try it out in the link below. Buy 2 Get 1 Free.
data.why_it_works: Interpretation of execution, not measured performance: The ranked list creates a reason to keep watching until number four, and conceding that the popular ingredients are weak makes the product's extra two feel like the real difference. It reframes competitors without naming them.
data.transferable_move: Rank the category's common ingredients from weakest to strongest, admit the popular ones are weak, and show that rivals stop before the strong ones. Do not copy '99% fail', 'what exterminators use' or respiratory claims without a source.
data.opening_visual: Four-panel split of mint, cinnamon stick, oil dropper and pine cones with red label 'THE 4 THINGS MICE CAN'T TOLERATE'.
data.transition_to_product: 53.7 s, 'Sofyre has all four in one bag' with the bag held up.
data.proof_placement: Body animations sit in the #3 and #4 beats (32–40 s); exterminator claim follows product entry (59 s); checkout screenshot in the offer close (74.7 s).
